notes.title: Version 1.04 - Enemy changes
notes.notes:
New main enemy textures and improved animations and lighting.

Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.03 - Tutorial and Subtitles
notes.notes:
Echoes Of Madness has been characterized by having a mix of different mechanics with very different natures. We are very satisfied with the result and its reception but for the less experienced players in this genre it can be a bit confusing in the first nights. Therefore, we have added more accessibility to the tutorial and explanations of the mechanics that you will find in your passage through the psychiatric ward.

The subtitles of the dubbing have been improved to make them clearer to read.

notes.title: Halloween Update: Improved settings and optimizations
notes.notes:
We bring news for you to have a spooky night and... what better time than today to share them!

Based on requests from the community, we have added more video options (borderless full screen) and sensitivity settings. Taking advantage of this update, we have optimized the game to run at higher frame rates.

Happy Halloween!
